research.facts:

**How to access:** Log in → click "Bus Routing" → select student name → click "Bus Routing" tab [HIGH]
**Information provided:** Bus number, stop location, pickup time, drop-off time [HIGH]
**Transportation Space Available requests:** Opened July 20, 2026 via same portal [HIGH]
**D20 first day:** August 17 (orientation) / August 18 (first full day) — confirmed from July 28 coverage [HIGH]
**Source:** asd20.org/buses-and-transportation/
**Confidence:** HIGH throughout. Directly from ASD20 official site.
**Action items for families:**
1. Log into Extended Parent Portal at asd20.org
2. Navigate to Bus Routing
3. Select student
4. View bus number, stop, and times
5. Submit Transportation Space Available requests via same portal if needed
